## Summary

This site publishes engineering articles with a focus on systems thinking, memory safety, concurrency, and clear examples. Content is written for human readers and is also structured for search engines and AI retrieval systems.

## Primary topics

- C++: RAII, smart pointers, ownership, performance-minded native code
- Rust: ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, memory safety
- Python: asyncio, structured concurrency, backend productivity
- Cloudflare Workers: edge architecture, Durable Objects, storage, queues, and operations

- URL: https://blogs.sakshampy.in/blog/cpp-raii-smart-pointers/

- Summary: Explains RAII and when to use unique_ptr versus shared_ptr.

- URL: https://blogs.sakshampy.in/blog/rust-ownership-borrowing/
- Topic: Rust
- Summary: Practical walkthrough of ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes.

### Python Asyncio: Structured Concurrency That Scales

- URL: https://blogs.sakshampy.in/blog/python-asyncio-structured-concurrency/
- Topic: Python
- Summary: TaskGroup-based asyncio patterns with timeouts and clean cancellation.

### Cloudflare Workers in Depth: A Production Architecture

- URL: https://blogs.sakshampy.in/blog/cloudflare-workers-production-architecture/
- Topic: Cloudflare Workers
- Summary: Request lifetimes, Durable Objects, storage, queues, observability, and safe deployments.
